newsitem.title: USA: Navy gives up search for woman sailor lost at sea.
newsitem.headline: Navy gives up search for woman sailor lost at sea.

text.p: The Navy said on Friday it had called off the search for a woman sailor lost at sea from the aircraft carrier John F. Kennedy.
Rescuers gave up the search for Airman Nadia T. Aiten, 22, of Los Angeles, at sunset on Thursday, said Lt. Cmdr. Conrad Chun from the Kennedy's home base near Jacksonville, Fla.

The search was called off more than a day after Aiten was reported overboard on Wednesday during routine practice for Navy aviators. An investigation was underway but no details of the incident were released.
The Kennedy had just left its home port for a six-month tour of the Mediterranean. It was the first time the Kennedy has been at sea on an extended deployment with women.
